prompt: Maya puts £3 into her savings jar every week and never takes any out. How much will be in the jar after 12 weeks?
explanation: £3 a week for 12 weeks is 3 × 12 = £36 — small weekly amounts add up steadily, which is the whole idea behind regular saving.
